evidence.why: Renderer-supplied args array is forwarded almost unrestricted to spawn('git', ...), permitting dangerous git options (e.g. -c core.fsmonitor=, clone ext:: transport) that achieve command execution.

evidence.snippet: const cwd = options.cwd && typeof options.cwd === 'string' ? options.cwd : process.cwd();
evidence.why: cwd is taken directly from renderer-controlled options without resolving/confining to a fixed base directory, allowing the git process to run against an arbitrary filesystem path.
Renderer can override arbitrary environment variables for the spawned git process, widening attack surface (e.g. GIT_SSH, PATH-like vars).

controls_present: spawn with shell:false (no shell string injection)
